exitCriteria: run beta only with SOCIAL_MONITOR_RUNTIME_PROFILE=beta and durable Prisma/RabbitMQ adapters
keep in-memory adapters limited to local-dev and deterministic-test profiles
deploy event-relay and worker persistence, cursor, lease and scan reporter adapters against shared database/broker state
prove restart survival and deployed cross-process scan status/feed/summary visibility through a targeted integration smoke

runtimeModules.risk: topics, source bindings, scan policies, scan jobs, outbox events and idempotency records can opt into Prisma, and scan command publishing can opt into RabbitMQ, but default local mode is still process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Monitoring repositories, outbox events and idempotency records can opt into Prisma with MONITORING_PERSISTENCE=prisma; scan command publishing can opt into RabbitMQ with MONITORING_SCAN_QUEUE=rabbitmq; event-relay can dispatch Prisma outbox events to RabbitMQ with start:event-relay; remaining blocker is deployment evidence with shared DATABASE_URL/RABBITMQ_URL

runtimeModules.risk: feed items are process-local and not shared with ingestion workers
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: FeedRestModule can opt into Prisma read persistence with FEED_PERSISTENCE=prisma; worker runtime can share Prisma source/cursor/feed projection state with INGESTION_WORKER_PERSISTENCE=prisma

runtimeModules.risk: per-user relevance weights, source/topic preferences, muted providers, feedback-learning signals and memory projection retry state are process-local unless relevance persistence is durable
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: RelevanceRestModule can opt into Prisma user relevance profiles, feedback signals and relevance memory projection state with RELEVANCE_PERSISTENCE=prisma; beta runtime must keep this selector durable so personalized ranking, digest selection, summary evidence weighting and memory projection retries survive restarts

runtimeModules.risk: summary jobs, artifacts, feedback, policies and events can opt into Prisma, and summary job publishing can opt into RabbitMQ, but default local mode is still process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: SummaryRestModule can opt into Prisma job/artifact/feedback/policy persistence and durable outbox events with SUMMARY_PERSISTENCE=prisma; summary job publishing can opt into RabbitMQ with SUMMARY_JOB_QUEUE_MODE=rabbitmq; event-relay can dispatch Prisma outbox events to RabbitMQ with start:event-relay; remaining blocker is deployment evidence with shared DATABASE_URL/RABBITMQ_URL

runtimeModules.risk: delivery attempts, digests, digest schedules, realtime replay events, webhook endpoints, encrypted webhook secrets, webhook replay nonce state, notification preferences and digest source reads can opt into Prisma but default local mode
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Delivery persistence can opt into Prisma with DELIVERY_PERSISTENCE=prisma; webhook secret durability additionally requires DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Prisma digest assembly reads persisted summary artifacts and feed items. Delivery attempt dispatch can opt into RabbitMQ command transport in delivery-service with DELIVERY_ATTEMPT_DISPATCH_TARGET=queue and DELIVERY_ATTEMPT_DISPATCH_QUEUE=rabbitmq. Webhook delivery can opt into signed HTTP POST transport with DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_PROVIDER=http, and beta runtime must use DELIVERY_ENABLED_CHANNELS=webhook so in-memory email/in_app delivery cannot look successful. Remaining blocker is real email transport and deployed shared-infra evidence.

runtimeModules.risk: source targets, user subscriptions, subscription schedules and user summary preference overlays can opt into Prisma, but default local mode is still process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: SubscriptionsRestModule can opt into Prisma target, subscription, schedule and user summary preference persistence with SUBSCRIPTIONS_PERSISTENCE=prisma; beta runtime must use shared DATABASE_URL so per-user source monitoring and summary personalization survive restarts and are visible across API replicas

runtimeModules.risk: delivery attempt dispatch commands can use the local in-memory queue in deterministic smoke mode, so API and worker replicas do not share queued commands unless RabbitMQ mode is selected
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Delivery service can publish delivery.attempt.send commands through RabbitMQ with DELIVERY_ATTEMPT_DISPATCH_QUEUE=rabbitmq and consume them with DELIVERY_ATTEMPT_QUEUE_READER=rabbitmq; check:delivery-attempt-queue-drain-loop proves the queue boundary and worker drain path in deterministic mode

runtimeModules.risk: API keys disappear on restart and cannot be shared across API replicas
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IdentityRestModule can opt into Prisma hashed API key persistence with IDENTITY_PERSISTENCE=prisma; keep in-memory only for deterministic local smoke

runtimeModules.risk: audit records, rate limits and quota reservations are process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: UsageRestModule can opt into Prisma public API audit, rate-limit bucket and quota bucket persistence with USAGE_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining hardening is distributed conditional quota update/Redis strategy for high concurrency

runtimeModules.risk: scan dead-letter support view is process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IngestionRestModule can opt into Prisma scan failure queue inspection with INGESTION_SUPPORT_PERSISTENCE=prisma; keep in-memory only for deterministic local smoke

runtimeModules.risk: worker scan attempts, source items, cursors, leases, failures, projected feed and default scan command reader are process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IngestionWorkerModule can opt into Prisma source item, cursor, feed projection, scan failure queue, scan attempt and scan lease persistence with INGESTION_WORKER_PERSISTENCE=prisma; scan command reading can opt into RabbitMQ with INGESTION_SCAN_QUEUE_READER=rabbitmq; platform inbox dedupe can use PrismaInboxStoreAdapter when event consumers are wired through it; check:cross-process-scheduler proves Prisma-backed scheduling into RabbitMQ command publication; remaining blocker is deployed shared-infra evidence

runtimeModules.risk: GitHub repository trend history is process-local unless the ingestion worker uses durable Prisma persistence
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: GitHub repo radar trend history can opt into Prisma with INGESTION_WORKER_PERSISTENCE=prisma through PrismaGitHubRepositoryTrendHistoryRepository; beta runtime must use shared DATABASE_URL so trend baselines and source metadata projections survive restarts

runtimeModules.risk: default summary worker queue reader drains only process-local commands when API and worker run in the same process
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IntelligenceWorkerModule can opt into RabbitMQ summary job reading with INTELLIGENCE_SUMMARY_QUEUE_READER=rabbitmq; queue drain loop can be enabled with INTELLIGENCE_SUMMARY_QUEUE_DRAIN_LOOP=enabled, while repository polling remains the local fallback

runtimeNoopAdapters.risk: summary memory context and feedback learning are disabled when SUMMARY_MEMORY_MODE is left at the local default
runtimeNoopAdapters.durableReplacementPlan: beta runtime must set SUMMARY_MEMORY_MODE=memo-stack with INFINITY_CONTEXT_URL and INFINITY_CONTEXT_TOKEN so summary context and feedback memory survive outside the API process

runtimeNoopAdapters.risk: default worker execution does not update durable scan job status across the monitoring boundary
runtimeNoopAdapters.durableReplacementPlan: use INGESTION_SCAN_REPORTER=monitoring with MONITORING_PERSISTENCE=prisma after shared queue/feed/cursor runtime gaps are resolved
